verdict.rationale: iTerm2 has a built-in LLM chat window that can read linked sessions' terminal contents to give context-aware help, explain output with annotations, and run commands. That is AI-generated insight and suggestions from the user's own terminal data inside the product (gh-6), and it also works in browser sessions (gh-16). The generative AI features need an optional plugin (docs-15) and, per community reports, the user's own OpenAI key (comm-1, comm-2); this is setup friction rather than a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the insight and annotation behavior, and independent hands-on reports of output quality.
